title: Stopscan
summary: Stopscan is a power primarily used on documents to prevent another Seeker from scanning them into their respective Tome.

sections.heading: History
sections.text: Stopscan was used by DeFoe on the map of Basilisk House in an attempt to confuse the Huntik team. In order to scan the map into her Cypherdex, Sophie Casterwill had to use Breakspell. Unfortunately, with DeFoe having already scanned the map on his Teknonomicon, the team abruptly fell into his ambush. [Absent Heroes]

full_text:
Stopscan is a power primarily used on documents to prevent another Seeker from scanning them into their respective Tome.

== History ==
Stopscan was used by DeFoe on the map of Basilisk House in an attempt to confuse the Huntik team. In order to scan the map into her Cypherdex, Sophie Casterwill had to use Breakspell. Unfortunately, with DeFoe having already scanned the map on his Teknonomicon, the team abruptly fell into his ambush. [Absent Heroes]

== History ==
Stopscan was used by [[DeFoe]] on the map of [[Basilisk House]] in an attempt to confuse the [[Huntik]] team. In order to scan the map into her [[Cypherdex]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] had to use [[Breakspell]]. Unfortunately, with DeFoe having already scanned the map on his [[Teknonomicon]], the team abruptly fell into his ambush. {{source|Absent Heroes}}
